name: Nevada
summary: Statutes, Constitution, court rules (NRCP, NRAP, SCR, RPC, district-court rules) and the NAC are all one-page-per-chapter/rule-set HTML on leg.state.nv.us with constructible URLs and #anchors; fetch_doc.py reads them in full, but WebFetch sees only the first ~110K characters, so later sections of long chapters (NRS 41.130, Const. art. 6, NRAP 36, SCR) need the script or Justia's per-section NRS pages. Case law: the appellate courts' ACIS portal is a JavaScript app, but its public JSON API (acis-api.nvcourts.gov) lists every Supreme Court advance opinion since 2000, Court of Appeals opinions since 2015 and unpublished orders, and serves the PDFs; nvcourts.gov itself is behind a Cloudflare challenge for scripts. Subsequent history (Court of Appeals → petition for review → Supreme Court) sits on the same docket number in ACIS. Justia is the tier-2 fallback for NRS, cases and (stale) Constitution; Cornell LII mirrors the NAC.

citation_map.notes: Nevada's own statutory citation form is 'NRS 41.130' with no section sign (NRS 220.170(4) prescribes it); Bluebook is 'Nev. Rev. Stat. § 41.130'. The section number encodes the chapter (digits and letters before the dot), so NRS/NAC citations are fully constructible. A range 'NRS 41.0305 to 41.039, inclusive' is a span: take the first section. Advance opinions are cited '142 Nev., Adv. Op. 65, ___ P.3d ___ (2026)' (Supreme Court Law Library guide; ACIS docket text writes 'Adv. Opn. No.'); once the Nevada Reports page is printed, cite 'Nev.' with parallel P.3d. Court of Appeals opinions share the Nev. series with no distinct court designation in Nev. cites; Bluebook P.3d-only cites use '(Nev. App. YYYY)' and older practice '(Nev. Ct. App.)'. NRAP 36(c)(3): unpublished dispositions are citable for persuasive value only if issued by the Supreme Court on or after Jan. 1, 2016 or by the Court of Appeals on or after Aug. 15, 2024, cited by docket number and date with '(unpublished disposition)'. Docket numbers are 5-digit; Court of Appeals matters carry '-COA' on the same number, and a petition for review is decided on that same docket. Routing guards: 'SCR', 'RPC', 'DCR' and bare 'Rule 12(b)(5)' are shared with other states — route them here only with Nevada context (Nev./Nevada/NRS nearby). 'NRS', 'NAC', 'NRCP', 'NRAP', 'EDCR', 'WDCR' are Nevada-specific. A bare 'No. 12345' docket, 'Supreme Court Rule N' and 'R001-25' File numbers are generic shapes: route them here only with Nevada context (a '-COA' suffix is Nevada-specific). Nevada has no separate rules-of-evidence set: evidence law is NRS chapters 47-56 (e.g. NRS 48.035), handled by the NRS pattern. A parallel cite ('142 Nev., Adv. Op. 6, 573 P.3d 101 (Nev. App. 2026)') matches both the advance-opinion and the P.3d pattern: prefer the advance-opinion route. WL numbers cannot be turned into free URLs: search ACIS by party name or docket number. CourtListener ids 'nev' and 'nevapp' are from memory and unverified. Bare 'SCR N' is shared with Wisconsin's Supreme Court Rules; it routes here only once Nevada is established. The colon form 'SCR 20:1.7' is Wisconsin's.

sources.title: Nevada Revised Statutes (Legislative Counsel Bureau)
sources.publisher: Nevada Legislative Counsel Bureau, Legal Division
sources.official_status_evidence: NRS 220.170(3) makes the printed, certified copies of NRS the official codified version and prima facie evidence; the web edition carries no certification or UELMA statement (https://www.leg.state.nv.us/NRS/NRS-220.html).
sources.coverage: All NRS titles and chapters (Preliminary Chapter = NRS-000), one HTML page per chapter with every section's text and source notes.

access.pattern_rules: From 'NRS C.S': chapter = digits before the dot, zero-padded to 3, plus any upper-case letter suffix (41 → 041; 41A → 041A; 0.025 → 000). Section = the digits after the dot exactly as written, including leading zeros (41.130 → Sec130; 41.0305 → Sec0305). Anchor = 'NRS' + padded chapter + suffix + 'Sec' + section (NRS041Sec130, NRS041ASec003). Host is case-insensitive (leg.state.nv.us/nrs/nrs-011.html also serves).
access.navigation: Not needed: the title/chapter index lists chapters only (no section ranges), but the chapter is read directly from the section number.

automation.robots_txt: User-agent * disallows /*.axd, */Reports/*, /App/Opinions/*, */ExhibitDocument/*, two FiscalNote paths; /NRS, /NAC, /Const, /CourtRules, /Register, /Statutes allowed
automation.notes: WebFetch on constructed chapter URLs waits on user approval (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED seen for NRS-011, NRS-041 and NRS-041A); use fetch_doc.py as the primary route. WebFetch sees only the first ~106-120K characters of a leg.state.nv.us page in total; offset=100000 reaches the tail of that window and no further (NRS ch. 41: body stops at NRS 41.0395 of 41.970; Constitution: stops in Art. 5 § 9). Everything later is reachable only by fetch_doc.py. Pages are windows-1252 (MS Word export): curly quotes, apostrophes, section signs and non-breaking spaces come out of fetch_doc.py as U+FFFD; quote-verify plain-ASCII runs of words (verify tolerates the whitespace runs).

sources.coverage: Supreme Court advance opinions from May 2000 (2,125 entries); Court of Appeals opinions from Mar. 2015 (95); dispositional orders (unpublished) for both courts (COA 9,532; Supreme ≥10,000 — counts cap at 10,000); full docket of each case since about 2000.

access.pattern_rules: court_uuid: Supreme Court dc01122c-a19d-4eb7-bfe9-5b96e93c26fd; Court of Appeals 74764f58-a87f-4ec5-8233-7a1255e410b3. type: 1000014 = Opinion/Dispositional (advance opinions); 1000018 = Order/Dispositional (unpublished orders); filter a subtype with docketEntryHeader.docketEntrySubTypeID (e.g. 1000233 Opinion on Supreme Court Review, 1000339 Order Denying Petition for Review, 1000336 Order Granting Petition for Review). Date window: docketEntryHeader.docketEntryFiledDateFrom/To. Each row gives documentLinkUUID, caseInstanceUUID, filedDate, docket number, case title and a description that includes the advance-opinion number ('142 Nev. Adv. Opn. No. 65'). PDF: https://acis-api.nvcourts.gov/courts/{court_uuid}/cms/case/{caseInstanceUUID}/docketentrydocuments/{documentLinkUUID} (court_uuid must be the UUID; '1' → HTTP 400). Build the PDF URL from the SAME listing row's caseInstanceUUID with that row's court UUID: Court of Appeals rows carry their own COA case instance (90082-COA: 84f40c27...), different from the Supreme Court instance returned by cases?caseHeader.caseNumber=90082 (bd5396a8...). By docket: GET /courts/cms/cases?caseHeader.caseNumber={docket} (drop any -COA suffix) → caseInstanceUUID and originatingCourtCases; then GET /courts/{court_uuid}/cms/cases/{caseInstanceUUID}/docketentries?size=300 (adding sort= gives HTTP 500). caseHeader.caseNumber is ignored by the docketentrydocuments search.
access.navigation: Human portal (acis.nvcourts.gov) is a Vue app: WebFetch gets an empty shell and its search URLs exceed WebFetch's URL-length limit. Use the API (config: acis.nvcourts.gov/properties.js apiRoot).

sources.title: Petitions for review and later history on the ACIS docket
sources.coverage: Court of Appeals cases are pushed down from the Supreme Court (NRAP 17) and keep the same 5-digit docket; the petition for review (NRAP 40B), the order granting/denying it and any Supreme Court opinion on review are entries on that one docket. US Supreme Court cert notices are docketed too (subtypes 1000148 cert denied, 1000149 cert filed).

access.pattern_rules: Strip '-COA' from the docket; the case result gives caseInstanceUUID → GET https://acis-api.nvcourts.gov/courts/dc01122c-a19d-4eb7-bfe9-5b96e93c26fd/cms/cases/{caseInstanceUUID}/docketentries?size=300 and read entries typed 'Post-Judgment Petition', 'Post-Judgment Order', 'Opinion/Dispositional' (subtype 'Opinion on Supreme Court Review'), 'Case Status Update' ('Transferred to/from Court of Appeals'), 'Remittitur'. For recent review grants/denials across all cases: docketentrydocuments?docketEntryHeader.docketEntrySubTypeID=1000336 (granted) or 1000339 (denied). From a district-court case number, the case result's originatingCourtCases lists the trial docket.

script_candidates.why: Public, unauthenticated JSON API (acis-api.nvcourts.gov): document search by court UUID, docket-entry type/subtype and filed-date range; case search by docket number; full docket entries; PDF download by UUIDs. A script maps 'NNN Nev., Adv. Op. NN' or a docket number to the PDF deterministically.
Same API: docket number → docket entries gives petition-for-review history, remittitur and US cert notices in one call.
Static chapter HTML with stable anchors; a script can slice one section by anchor and transcode windows-1252, avoiding the WebFetch window.
Yearly numerical indexes list every LCB File No. and stage PDF.
